subject.title: feat(agents): per-agent outbound A2A allowlist override

question: Should OpenClaw accept outbound-only `agents.list[].tools.agentToAgent.allow` as the core per-agent A2A authorization shape for now, or defer it to the broader session/A2A scoping work?
rationale: This is a new config and authorization boundary that is technically repairable but still changes the supported security model for multi-agent session tools.

options.title: Accept after repairs
options.body: Normalize exact allow entries, remove the changelog edit, keep the documented outbound-only semantics, and merge after owner review.

options.title: Defer to broader scoping
options.body: Close or pause this PR in favor of the broader per-agent session/A2A model tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/59149.

options.title: Request target-side policy
options.body: Ask for a bidirectional or receiver-side policy design before accepting any new per-agent A2A config surface.

recommendation.title: Accept after repairs
recommendation.body: Normalize exact allow entries, remove the changelog edit, keep the documented outbound-only semantics, and merge after owner review.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the strongest ownership signal across config normalization, plugin SDK policy helpers, and session-tool authorization surfaces.
